name: Phan-Tungtap
instructions: 1. Roast the dried fermented fish (Tungtap) over an open flame or in a pan until crispy and fragrant.
2. In a mixing bowl, mash the boiled potatoes thoroughly.
3. Crush the roasted fish into small pieces or a coarse paste.
4. Add the chopped onions, green chilies, grated ginger, and salt to the mashed potatoes.
5. Combine the roasted fish with the potato mixture and mix well to ensure the flavors are distributed evenly.
6. Garnish with fresh coriander leaves and serve as a side dish with steamed rice.
description: Phan-Tungtap is a signature dish of the Khasi community in Meghalaya. It highlights the local preference for fermented ingredients, specifically 'Tungtap', which is a pungent dried fish paste that provides a deep umami flavor to the otherwise simple mashed potato preparation.
